rules: candidate QIDs proposed by the agent (Wikidata search endpoints were throttled machine-wide on 2026-10-16), each verified with a Special:EntityData snapshot fetched through WDHARVEST's locked, budgeted client (src/reva/kg/harvest.py budgeted_client, mode linked_data); raw responses archived content-addressed in var/kg/objects (raw_sha256)

'verified' = the item has P31 and its English label or an English alias equals the UNTC page title or the connector's label (normalised: case, punctuation, '(yyyy)'); otherwise qid null and the KG keeps untc:treaty:<mtdsg>

no Wikidata identifier keyed by the MTDSG number was found on the fetched items (the Paris Agreement item carries a UNTC showDetails URL in P973 'described at URL', keyed by the UNTC objid, not by MTDSG), so the mapping is this evidenced table

most agent-proposed candidates were rejected by the check (wrong items); their treaties stay unmapped until candidates come from a search (WDQS/CirrusSearch throttled) or from KGHIST's harvested treaty items
Wikidata is community-edited: pending maintainer review
